ingredients.name: soft bread crumbs (or 1/2 cup fine dry bread crumbs)

steps.instruction: Put 2 pounds of ground bison meat and 1 1/2 cups of soft bread crumbs in a large bowl.
Add 1 egg and 1/2 cup of milk.
Add 1/2 cup of chopped onion and 1/2 chopped medium green pepper.
Add 2 teaspoons of Worcestershire sauce, if you like.
Add 1 teaspoon of garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.
Shape the mixture into a loaf, or pat it into a lightly oiled loaf pan.
Bake at 300 °F for 45 minutes, until a thermometer reads 160 °F.
steps.spoken: Bake at 300 °F for 45 minutes, until a thermometer in the middle of the loaf reads 160 °F.
